claim: Recombinant Blastocystis SCS is ATP-specific and the protein is in the MRO
finding: ATP-specific, GTP inactive; kcat 133/min with ATP; SCS localises to the organelle matrix
context: Blastocystis ST1 NandII recombinant alpha/beta; immunolocalisation
confidence: High for specificity and location; says nothing about in vivo direction (assay run in the succinyl-CoA-forming direction)

claim: An ASCT/SCS couple operates in the Blastocystis organelle
finding: PNO, ASCT and succinate thiokinase activities measured in isolated MLO; incomplete Krebs cycle; hydrogenase activity not detected
context: Blastocystis sp. subtype 7, isolated organelle fraction
confidence: Medium-high; different subtype from this entry; activities measured, flux direction not measured

claim: The organelle cannot make ATP chemiosmotically
finding: Complexes I and II present, no complex III, IV or F1Fo ATPase; [FeFe] hydrogenase localised to the organelle; incomplete TCA; organellar genome
confidence: High; EST-based absence calls are weaker than genome-based, but reproduced here on UP000078348

claim: Organellar SCS runs ATP-forming inside an ASCT/SCS cycle
finding: ATP production by the ASCT/SCS cycle demonstrated directly in organello; loss of both the TCA and the ASCT/SCS cycle arrests growth, either alone does not
context: Trypanosoma brucei procyclic form, RNAi lines
confidence: High for T. brucei; transfers pathway logic, not a Blastocystis measurement

claim: ASCT, not acetyl-CoA thioesterase, is the ATP-coupled acetate route
finding: ASCT null is ~1000-fold more oligomycin sensitive; F1-beta RNAi lethal in the ASCT null background
confidence: High; readout depends on an F1Fo ATP synthase that Blastocystis lacks

claim: The ASCT/SCS cycle makes ATP as a coupled pair
finding: Reconstituted cycle is acetyl-CoA specific and has a higher kcat than yeast and bacterial ATP synthases
context: Trypanosoma brucei recombinant enzymes in vitro
confidence: High for the chemistry; in vitro

claim: ASCT needs a high organellar succinate pool
finding: Leishmania ASCT Km(acetyl-CoA) 0.26 mM, Km(succinate) 6.9 mM; succinyl-CoA recycled to succinate by SCS producing ATP
context: Leishmania mexicana promastigote, partially purified enzyme
confidence: High; the 6.9 mM Km sets the succinate concentration that constrains the SCS driving force

claim: An acetyl-CoA hydrolase family protein is a genuine succinate-dependent ASCT
finding: TvASCT identified in hydrogenosomes; CoA-transferase activity is succinate-dependent; similar to yeast acetyl-CoA hydrolase
context: Trichomonas vaginalis hydrogenosomes, heterologous and homologous expression
confidence: High; defines the family that the ST1 NandII proteins belong to

claim: SCS is a hydrogenosomal matrix enzyme in the measured anaerobe
finding: alpha-SCS in purified hydrogenosomes, soluble at high pH, 9-residue cleaved presequence
confidence: High for location; direction asserted, not measured, in that paper

claim: A convergently similar organelle excretes succinate
finding: N. ovalis organelle uses fumarate as terminal electron acceptor and produces succinate as a major end product; metabolism stated to be remarkably similar to Blastocystis
confidence: Medium-high; succinate as a net product works against, not for, the ATP-forming direction

claim: The subtype of this entry encodes an ASCT partner
finding: A0A196SMF3 (OAO17397.1) and A0A196SNA7 (OAO17721.1), 521 aa, 58.5-59.7% identical to the T. vaginalis ASCT family, 52.8-54.3% to yeast Ach1; the only CoA-transferase family I proteins in the proteome
context: Blastocystis sp. ATCC 50177/NandII proteome, Smith-Waterman BLOSUM62
confidence: Medium-high; orthology is clear, but family members can act as acetyl-CoA hydrolases with no ATP yield

claim: Direction is decided by mass action, not by the assay
finding: dG'o(ATP-forming) between -1.8 and -4.6 kJ/mol; at Pi 10 mM and ATP/ADP 5, net ATP needs succinyl-CoA/CoA > 0.68 at 5 mM succinate and > 1.35 at 10 mM
context: Standard thermodynamic calculation at 37 C, K' 2-6
confidence: High for the arithmetic; the organellar metabolite concentrations are unmeasured

claim: An ATP-coupled acetate route exists that bypasses SCS
finding: Three ADP-forming acetyl-CoA synthetases (A0A196SMQ0, A0A196S6S6, A0A196S9Z5, 736 aa) with presequence-like N-termini indistinguishable from organelle-localised controls
confidence: Medium; localisation is predicted, not measured

finding: No 5-aminolevulinate synthase and no heme pathway genes at all in either genome; no lysine-to-succinyl-CoA route; methylmalonyl-CoA mutase and propionyl-CoA carboxylase present as the only remaining succinyl-CoA node
context: Blastocystis ST1 NandII and ST7 proteomes
confidence: Medium-high; absence calls on a draft WGS assembly carry residual risk
